race.comment: ROCK FEST (4) is an exciting gelding on resumption, placing in the Fairetha and WA Guineas before the break. Been off the scene since, but he did trial in February. Nice trial coming in this time and with stacks of upside, he can land the knockout blow on resumption. OURGIRLCANRUN (10) is a handy type who has speed to burn, going back-to-back before the break. She's trialled well coming in and she's another with plenty of upside. Drawn out, but she can work across from out wide and make every post a winner. NICCIANA (9) trialled well coming into this and is a first-up winner in the past. May need a touch of luck from the barrier, but he's a classy type who can't be discounted. HURRICANE HARLEY (2) was too good a month ago and can't be left out with this shaping similarly. POND MASTER (3) is better than he showed last start and can improve with the blinkers going back on.
